page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Margin notes run down the left margin, beside the lines they refer to. No right margin notes. Running head top centre, page number top left.

main_text.p: tris contulit: quem ille fororis filium ag-Gen.29.nitum, in hospitium benigne receepit. E-Iacobi nupt.rant Laban duæ filiæ, Lia & Rachel. Sed Lia oculis deformior, Rachel pulchra fu-isse traditur. Cujus specie Iacob captus, amore virginis conflagrabat: eamq; sibi in matrimonio a patre postulans, septem annorum servitio se mancipavit. Sed im-pleto tempore, Lia ei supponitur: ac rursum septe in servitio subditur, atq; ei Rachel traditur. Sed hanc diu sterilem, Liam Iac.filii.fecundam fuisse accepimus. Filiorum quos ex Lia Iacob habuit, hæc sunt nomina; Gen.30.Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Iudas, Isachar, Za-bulon, Dina. Ex ancilla vero Liæ, Gad & Aser. Ex ancilla Rachel, Dan & a Nephtali. vide nota.Nephtalim nati sunt. At Rachel, desperato jam partu, Ioseph edidit. Tum Iacob redire ad patrem cupiens, cum ei Laban socer partem pecorum mercede servitii dedisset, ob quæ parū sibi eū æquū gener Iacob ratus, dolū ab eo suspectas, clam profectus est vicesi-mo primo Gen.31.fere anno, quam advenerat. Ra-chel, viro inscio, patris idola furto abstulit, qua injuria Laban generū persecutus, nō repertis idolis, pace facta, regressus est: multum obtestatus generū, ne uxores fili-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "receepit" (the scan shows a doubled e, possibly receepit or recepit); "septe" (written with a stroke over the e, probably septem abbreviated); "Iudas" and "Isachar" read from a faint scan. The printed "Afer" in the genealogy is rendered "Aser" with long s as plain s; the printing may be an error for Aser, and the original is left as read. The left-margin note "Iacobi nupt." is two printed lines ("Iacobi" above "nupt."). The note "a Nephtali. vide nota." is printed in three short lines and is set out here as one note. The catchword "abus" stands at the foot right.
